column2: Hand-authored Preferred-tier seed for LFŠ (Letní filmová škola Uherské Hradiště).
Every row is attested against local/lfs/txt/** by scripts/curated_dict.py; a row whose
evidence regex does not match the corpus fails the build. Evidence is never invented.
Membership test used for every row (good-crossword skill): would a reader recognise this
word as belonging to a FILM FESTIVAL with the clue covered? That is why sál, host, úvod,
klub, stan, aula, ceny, noc, program are absent even though they are the highest-salience
tokens in the corpus — they are festival *layout*, not festival *vocabulary*.
score 200 = unmistakably cinema or unmistakably LFŠ; 150 = solidly thematic.

column2: Block 2 — picked by hand out of local/lfs/dict/lfs_candidates.csv (corpus-mined, salience-ranked).
Kept only where the bare word evokes CINEMA. Rejected from the same band because they do not:
satira, klasik, ocenění, hrdinka, kultura, literatura, realita, respekt, adaptace-as-generic,
plus every country name the film annotations dragged in (senegal, orinoko, ardeny, cherbourg…).

column2: Block 3 — single-word titles and directors from the 2026 programme (source local/lfs/program/program_2026.json).
Only titles that a Czech cinephile recognises standing alone; plot words and multiword fragments excluded.
Block 4 — short cinema words, added because the grid's scarce lengths are 3-5 and the tier
was thin there. Same membership test: the BARE word must evoke cinema.
Rejected from the same band although they are the corpus's most frequent LFŠ tokens:
sál, úvod, stan, host, hala, aula-as-generic — an attendee knows them, but with the clue
covered they are festival *layout*, not festival *vocabulary*, so they would spend the
objective on nothing. They get LFŠ-voiced clues from the Standard tier instead.
